text: Movement in the brush on both shoulders of the road, and it is not the wind.
A bird goes up from the scrub with nothing under it, and then the scrub itself moves.
The road narrows, the birdsong stops, and somebody up the slope shifts their weight.

lines.speaker: Sera
text: They've seen us. They stopped pretending about a hundred paces back.
Both sides. Whoever set this has done it before and been paid for it.
They want us strung out on the road. Don't give it to them.

lines.speaker: Bram
text: Hold the road. Make them come down off the hills.
Backs together, feet on the stone. Let them spend the hill.
Nobody chases. They break on us or not at all.
